items.text: help chahiye
plan change karna
kab tak milega
price batao please
extra data chahiye
kaunsa plan best hai

items.context: Kya aap apna plan change karna chahte hain?
items.text: haan kar do

items.context: Kya main aapka current plan deactivate kar du?
items.text: ji badal dena
turant chahiye
mera current plan thoda mehenga lag raha hai
kya aapke paas koi budget friendly plan hai
main apna recharge plan upgrade karna chahta hu
ismein aur zyada internet chahiye mujhe
kya main monthly plan se yearly plan pe switch kar sakta hu
kab se ye naya plan effective hoga mera
please mujhe plan ke benefits acche se samjha do

items.context: Kya aapko apne liye koi budget plan chahiye?
items.text: kya aap mujhe sabse sasta data plan recommend kar sakte hain

items.context: Kya aap international call facility chahte hain apne plan mein?
items.text: main apne plan mein international calls bhi include karna chahta hu

items.context: Aapka mahine ka average data usage kitna hai?
items.text: mujhe apne data usage ke hisaab se plan chahiye

items.context: Kya aap apne plan ki validity extend karna chahte hain?
items.text: kya mujhe apne plan ka validity badhana padega naya plan lene ke liye

items.context: Kya aap apna balance new plan mein transfer karna chahte hain?
items.text: kya main plan change karte hi apne existing balance ka use kar sakta hu
mera current prepaid plan thoda expensive hai aur mujhe lagta hai ki main uska pura faida nahi utha pa raha hu main koi aisa plan chahata hu jismein zyada data aur calls included ho
kya aapke paas koi aisa plan available hai jismein international calling facility di gayi ho main kab se apne international family members ko call karna chahta hu
mujhe apne plan ko upgrade karna hai isliye mujhe pata karna hai ki naye plans mein kya kya offers hain aur kitne me upgrade ho sakta hu

items.context: Aap apne plan mein changes karna chahte hain toh bataiye kya zarurat hai?
items.text: main apna existing plan change karna chahata hu kyunki mujhe zyada internet chahiye abhi jo plan use kar raha hu usme data kam padta hai

items.context: Kya main aapko naye plans ke baare mein batata hu?
items.text: naye plans ke baare mein mujhe detail mein batayiye jismein call aur data dono ka best combination mile aise plan dhoondh raha hu main

items.context: Kya aapko apna plan type change karna hai prepaid se postpaid ya postpaid se prepaid?
items.text: kya main apne postpaid plan ko prepaid mein convert kar sakta hu agar ha to process kya hai mujhe bataiye

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: telecom
Intent: plan_change - wants to change or understand a plan
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: plain and direct

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
